dependencies: Lean core only (no Mathlib, no ZTL import)

legion_decide_note: compiled binaries are not byte-reproducible; behavioural equivalence of a clean rebuild shown by 12,000-case + 27-effect + 44-test equivalence (G5_RELEASE/REPRO_*)

theorems.name: LegionCore.admit_full_T
theorems.statement: ∀ {sp : Spec} {s : State} {r : Req}, admission Guards.full sp s r = V.T → s.phase = Phase.running ∧ (∃ tk a, sp.task? r.task = some tk ∧ sp.actorOf r.cred = some a ∧ tk.owner = a ∧ tk.write = true ∧ tk.target = r.target ∧ depsClosed s tk = true ∧ s.used tk.resKey + tk.demand ≤ sp.capOf tk.resKey ∧ r.permit.actor = a) ∧ r.permit ∈ s.issued ∧ r.permit.task = r.task ∧ r.permit.cmd = r.cmd ∧ r.permit.target = r.target ∧ r.permit.mission = sp.mission ∧ r.permit.epoch = s.epoch ∧ r.permit.uid = s.uid ∧ r.permit.wid = s.wid ∧ ¬r.permit.nonce ∈ s.usedNonces ∧ ¬r.cmd ∈ s.fenced ∧ (∀ (e : Effect), e ∈ s.ledger → e.cmd ≠ r.cmd) ∧ (∀ (e : Effect), e ∈ s.ledger → e.task ≠ r.task) ∧ ¬r.task ∈ s.closed ∧ ztl sp s r.task = V.T ∧ s.chash = sp.mission ∧ s.cver = 0

theorems.name: LegionCore.reach_inv
theorems.statement: ∀ {sp : Spec} {uid wid : Nat} {s : State}, Reach Guards.full sp uid wid s → LegionCore.Inv sp s

theorems.name: LegionCore.T1_admission_soundness
theorems.statement: ∀ {sp : Spec} {s s' : State} {c : Cmd} {e : Effect}, exec Guards.full sp s c = some s' → e ∈ s'.ledger → ¬e ∈ s.ledger → ∃ r, c = Cmd.actuate r ∧ e = effectOf sp r ∧ admission Guards.full sp s r = V.T ∧ r.permit ∈ s.issued ∧ r.permit.epoch = s.epoch ∧ s.phase = Phase.running ∧ ∃ tk a, sp.task? r.task = some tk ∧ sp.actorOf r.cred = some a ∧ tk.owner = a ∧ e.actor = a

theorems.name: LegionCore.T2_effect_after_deps
theorems.statement: ∀ {sp : Spec} {s s' : State} {c : Cmd} {e : Effect}, exec Guards.full sp s c = some s' → e ∈ s'.ledger → ¬e ∈ s.ledger → ∃ tk, sp.task? e.task = some tk ∧ ∀ (d : Nat), d ∈ tk.deps → d ∈ s.closed

theorems.name: LegionCore.T2_evidence_while_eligible
theorems.statement: ∀ {sp : Spec} {s s' : State} {t cred : Nat}, exec Guards.full sp s (Cmd.evidence t cred) = some s' → ∃ tk, sp.task? t = some tk ∧ sp.actorOf cred = some tk.owner ∧ ∀ (d : Nat), d ∈ tk.deps → d ∈ s.closed

theorems.name: LegionCore.T2_close_after_deps
theorems.statement: ∀ {sp : Spec} {s s' : State} {t : Nat}, exec Guards.full sp s (Cmd.close t) = some s' → ∃ tk, sp.task? t = some tk ∧ ∀ (d : Nat), d ∈ tk.deps → d ∈ s.closed

theorems.name: LegionCore.T2_causal_invariant
theorems.statement: ∀ {sp : Spec} {uid wid : Nat} {s : State}, Reach Guards.full sp uid wid s → ∀ (e : Effect), e ∈ s.ledger → ∃ tk, sp.task? e.task = some tk ∧ ∀ (d : Nat), d ∈ tk.deps → d ∈ s.closed

theorems.name: LegionCore.T3_resource_conservation
theorems.statement: ∀ {sp : Spec} {uid wid : Nat} {s : State}, Reach Guards.full sp uid wid s → ∀ (k : Nat), s.used k ≤ sp.capOf k

theorems.name: LegionCore.T3_over_capacity_refused
theorems.statement: ∀ {sp : Spec} {s : State} {r : Req} {tk : LegionCore.Task}, sp.task? r.task = some tk → sp.capOf tk.resKey < s.used tk.resKey + tk.demand → admission Guards.full sp s r ≠ V.T

theorems.name: LegionCore.T4_claimed_irrelevant
theorems.statement: ∀ (g : Guards) (sp : Spec) (s : State) (r : Req) (x : Nat), admission g sp s { cred := r.cred, claimed := x, task := r.task, target := r.target, cmd := r.cmd, permit := r.permit } = admission g sp s r

theorems.name: LegionCore.T4_permit_actor_bound
theorems.statement: ∀ {sp : Spec} {s : State} {r : Req} {a : Nat}, sp.actorOf r.cred = some a → r.permit.actor ≠ a → admission Guards.full sp s r ≠ V.T

theorems.name: LegionCore.T4_identity_isolation
theorems.statement: ∀ {sp : Spec} {s : State} {r : Req} {a : Nat}, sp.actorOf r.cred = some a → (∀ (tk : LegionCore.Task), sp.task? r.task = some tk → tk.owner ≠ a) → admission Guards.full sp s r ≠ V.T

theorems.name: LegionCore.T4_no_credential
theorems.statement: ∀ {sp : Spec} {s : State} {r : Req}, sp.actorOf r.cred = none → admission Guards.full sp s r ≠ V.T

theorems.name: LegionCore.T5_stale_no_seat
theorems.statement: ∀ (sp : Spec) (s : State) (r : Report) (t : Nat) (v : V), fresh sp s.now r = false → votes sp { phase := s.phase, uid := s.uid, wid := s.wid, epoch := s.epoch, now := s.now, issued := s.issued, usedNonces := s.usedNonces, fenced := s.fenced, ledger := s.ledger, verified := s.verified, evidenced := s.evidenced, closed := s.closed, reports := r :: s.reports, used := s.used, contract := s.contract, chash := s.chash, cver := s.cver, plan := s.plan } t v = votes sp s t v

theorems.name: LegionCore.T5_unknown_no_seat
theorems.statement: ∀ (sp : Spec) (s : State) (r : Report) (t : Nat) (v : V), r.value = V.Z → v ≠ V.Z → votes sp { phase := s.phase, uid := s.uid, wid := s.wid, epoch := s.epoch, now := s.now, issued := s.issued, usedNonces := s.usedNonces, fenced := s.fenced, ledger := s.ledger, verified := s.verified, evidenced := s.evidenced, closed := s.closed, reports := r :: s.reports, used := s.used, contract := s.contract, chash := s.chash, cver := s.cver, plan := s.plan } t v = votes sp s t v

theorems.name: LegionCore.T5_order_independent
theorems.statement: ∀ (sp : Spec) (s s' : State), s.reports.Perm s'.reports → s.now = s'.now → ∀ (t : Nat) (v : V), votes sp s t v = votes sp s' t v

theorems.name: LegionCore.T5_ztl_T_needs_seats
theorems.statement: ∀ {sp : Spec} {s : State} {t : Nat}, ztl sp s t = V.T → sp.f + 1 ≤ votes sp s t V.T ∧ votes sp s t V.F < sp.f + 1

theorems.name: LegionCore.T5_distinct_origins
theorems.statement: ∀ {sp : Spec} {uid wid : Nat} {s : State}, Reach Guards.full sp uid wid s → ∀ {t : Nat}, ztl sp s t = V.T → have L := List.filter (fun r => r.task == t && r.value == V.T && fresh sp s.now r) s.reports; (List.map (fun r => r.source) L).Nodup ∧ sp.f + 1 ≤ (List.map (fun r => r.source) L).length

theorems.name: LegionCore.T5_closure_needs_verification
theorems.statement: ∀ {sp : Spec} {uid wid : Nat} {s : State}, Reach Guards.full sp uid wid s → ∀ {t : Nat}, t ∈ s.closed → ∀ {tk : LegionCore.Task}, sp.task? t = some tk → tk.write = true → t ∈ s.verified ∧ ∃ e, e ∈ s.ledger ∧ e.task = t

theorems.name: LegionCore.T6_epoch_binding
theorems.statement: ∀ {sp : Spec} {s s' : State} {c : Cmd} {e : Effect}, exec Guards.full sp s c = some s' → e ∈ s'.ledger → ¬e ∈ s.ledger → ∃ r, c = Cmd.actuate r ∧ r.permit.epoch = s.epoch ∧ r.permit.uid = s.uid ∧ r.permit.wid = s.wid ∧ r.permit.mission = sp.mission ∧ s.phase = Phase.running

theorems.name: LegionCore.T6_epoch_revocation
theorems.statement: ∀ {sp : Spec} {uid wid : Nat} {s s' : State} {c : Cmd}, Reach Guards.full sp uid wid s → c = Cmd.start ∨ c = Cmd.bump ∨ c = Cmd.terminate → exec Guards.full sp s c = some s' → ∀ {r : Req}, r.permit ∈ s.issued → admission Guards.full sp s' r ≠ V.T

theorems.name: LegionCore.T6_not_running
theorems.statement: ∀ {sp : Spec} {s : State} {r : Req}, s.phase ≠ Phase.running → admission Guards.full sp s r ≠ V.T

theorems.name: LegionCore.T7_exactly_once
theorems.statement: ∀ {sp : Spec} {uid wid : Nat} {s : State}, Reach Guards.full sp uid wid s → (∀ (t : Nat), (List.filter (fun e => e.task == t) s.ledger).length ≤ 1) ∧ (∀ (c : Nat), (List.filter (fun e => e.cmd == c) s.ledger).length ≤ 1) ∧ ∀ (e : Effect), e ∈ s.ledger → ¬e.cmd ∈ s.fenced

theorems.name: LegionCore.T8_recovery_preservation
theorems.statement: ∀ {sp : Spec} {s s' : State} {c : Cmd}, LegionCore.Inv sp s → exec Guards.full sp s c = some s' → LegionCore.Inv sp s'

theorems.name: LegionCore.T8_retry_after_effect_refused
theorems.statement: ∀ {sp : Spec} {s : State} {r : Req} {e : Effect}, e ∈ s.ledger → e.task = r.task → admission Guards.full sp s r ≠ V.T

theorems.name: LegionCore.T8_fenced_never_executes
theorems.statement: ∀ {sp : Spec} {s : State} {r : Req}, r.cmd ∈ s.fenced → admission Guards.full sp s r ≠ V.T

theorems.name: LegionCore.T8_fence_requires_no_effect
theorems.statement: ∀ {sp : Spec} {s s' : State} {c : Nat}, exec Guards.full sp s (Cmd.fence c) = some s' → ∀ (e : Effect), e ∈ s.ledger → e.cmd ≠ c

theorems.name: LegionCore.T8_crash_stutter
theorems.statement: ∀ (g : Guards) (sp : Spec) (s : State), exec g sp s Cmd.crash = some s

theorems.name: LegionCore.T9_completion_soundness
theorems.statement: ∀ {sp : Spec} {uid wid : Nat} {s : State}, Reach Guards.full sp uid wid s → judgePass sp s → ∀ (tk : LegionCore.Task), tk ∈ sp.tasks → tk.mandatory = true → ∃ tk', sp.task? tk.id = some tk' ∧ tk.id ∈ s.closed ∧ (∀ (d : Nat), d ∈ tk'.deps → d ∈ s.closed) ∧ (tk'.write = true → tk.id ∈ s.verified ∧ ∃ e, e ∈ s.ledger ∧ e.task = tk.id) ∧ (tk'.write = false → tk.id ∈ s.evidenced)

theorems.name: LegionCore.T10_population_independence
theorems.statement: ∀ (sp : Spec) (uid wid : Nat) (s : State), Reach Guards.full sp uid wid s → LegionCore.Inv sp s

theorems.name: LegionCore.T11_mission_preserved
theorems.statement: ∀ {sp : Spec} {uid wid : Nat} {s : State}, Reach Guards.full sp uid wid s → s.cver = 0 → s.contract = sp.tasks ∧ s.chash = sp.mission

theorems.name: LegionCore.T11_immutable_without_authority
theorems.statement: ∀ {sp : Spec} {uid wid : Nat}, sp.specAuthority = [] → ∀ {s : State}, Reach Guards.full sp uid wid s → s.contract = sp.tasks ∧ s.chash = sp.mission ∧ s.cver = 0

theorems.name: LegionCore.T12_spec_change_authority
theorems.statement: ∀ {sp : Spec} {s s' : State} {c : Cmd}, exec Guards.full sp s c = some s' → s'.contract = s.contract ∧ s'.chash = s.chash ∧ s'.cver = s.cver ∨ ∃ cred tasks hh, c = Cmd.amend cred tasks hh ∧ cred ∈ sp.specAuthority ∧ s'.contract = tasks ∧ s'.chash = hh ∧ s'.cver = s.cver + 1 ∧ s'.epoch = s.epoch + 1 ∧ s'.issued = []

theorems.name: LegionCore.T12_epoch_changes
theorems.statement: ∀ {sp : Spec} {s s' : State} {cred : Nat} {tasks : List LegionCore.Task} {hh : Nat}, exec Guards.full sp s (Cmd.amend cred tasks hh) = some s' → s'.epoch ≠ s.epoch

theorems.name: LegionCore.T12_execution_agent_cannot_amend
theorems.statement: ∀ {sp : Spec} {s : State} {cred a : Nat}, (∀ (c : Nat), (sp.actorOf c).isSome = true → ¬c ∈ sp.specAuthority) → sp.actorOf cred = some a → ∀ (tasks : List LegionCore.Task) (hh : Nat), exec Guards.full sp s (Cmd.amend cred tasks hh) = none

theorems.name: LegionCore.T12_change_requires_readmission
theorems.statement: ∀ {sp : Spec} {s s' : State} {cred : Nat} {tasks : List LegionCore.Task} {hh : Nat}, exec Guards.full sp s (Cmd.amend cred tasks hh) = some s' → ∀ (r : Req), admission Guards.full sp s' r ≠ V.T

theorems.name: LegionCore.T13_admission_bound
theorems.statement: ∀ {sp : Spec} {s : State} {r : Req}, admission Guards.full sp s r = V.T → r.permit.mission = sp.mission ∧ s.chash = sp.mission ∧ s.cver = 0 ∧ ztl sp s r.task = V.T

theorems.name: LegionCore.T13_effect_bound
theorems.statement: ∀ {sp : Spec} {uid wid : Nat} {s : State}, Reach Guards.full sp uid wid s → ∀ (e : Effect), e ∈ s.ledger → e.mission = sp.mission

theorems.name: LegionCore.T13_judge_bound
theorems.statement: ∀ {sp : Spec} {uid wid : Nat} {s : State}, Reach Guards.full sp uid wid s → judgePass sp s → judgeVerdict sp sp.mission s

theorems.name: LegionCore.T13_foreign_receipt_rejected
theorems.statement: ∀ {sp : Spec} {s : State} {h : Nat} {e : Effect}, e ∈ s.ledger → e.mission ≠ h → ¬judgeVerdict sp h s

theorems.name: LegionCore.T13_other_contract_rejected
theorems.statement: ∀ {sp : Spec} {s : State} {h : Nat}, h ≠ sp.mission → ¬judgeVerdict sp h s

theorems.name: LegionCore.T14_nonvacuous_completion
theorems.statement: ∀ {sp : Spec} {uid wid : Nat} {s : State}, Reach Guards.full sp uid wid s → judgePass sp s → ∀ (o : LegionCore.Task), o ∈ sp.tasks → o.mandatory = true → ∃ o', sp.task? o.id = some o' ∧ o.id ∈ s.closed ∧ (o'.write = true → o.id ∈ s.verified ∧ ∃ e, e ∈ s.ledger ∧ e.task = o.id ∧ e.mission = sp.mission) ∧ (o'.write = false → o.id ∈ s.evidenced)

theorems.name: LegionCore.T15_replan_preserves_mission
theorems.statement: ∀ {sp : Spec} {s s' : State} {cred : Nat} {plan : List Nat}, exec Guards.full sp s (Cmd.replan cred plan) = some s' → s'.contract = s.contract ∧ s'.chash = s.chash ∧ s'.cver = s.cver ∧ s'.epoch = s.epoch ∧ s'.issued = s.issued ∧ s'.plan = plan

theorems.name: LegionCore.T15_plan_irrelevant_to_admission
theorems.statement: ∀ (g : Guards) (sp : Spec) (s : State) (r : Req) (p : List Nat), admission g sp { phase := s.phase, uid := s.uid, wid := s.wid, epoch := s.epoch, now := s.now, issued := s.issued, usedNonces := s.usedNonces, fenced := s.fenced, ledger := s.ledger, verified := s.verified, evidenced := s.evidenced, closed := s.closed, reports := s.reports, used := s.used, contract := s.contract, chash := s.chash, cver := s.cver, plan := p } r = admission g sp s r

theorems.name: LegionCore.T15_replan_allowed
theorems.statement: ∀ {sp : Spec} {s : State} {cred a : Nat}, sp.actorOf cred = some a → ∀ (plan : List Nat), exec Guards.full sp s (Cmd.replan cred plan) = some { phase := s.phase, uid := s.uid, wid := s.wid, epoch := s.epoch, now := s.now, issued := s.issued, usedNonces := s.usedNonces, fenced := s.fenced, ledger := s.ledger, verified := s.verified, evidenced := s.evidenced, closed := s.closed, reports := s.reports, used := s.used, contract := s.contract, chash := s.chash, cver := s.cver, plan := plan }

theorems.name: LegionCore.Journal.inv_fold
theorems.statement: ∀ (ts : List Journal.JTask) (rs : List Journal.Rec), Journal.Inv ts (Journal.fold ts rs)

theorems.name: LegionCore.Journal.confirmed_ordered
theorems.statement: ∀ (ts : List Journal.JTask) (rs : List Journal.Rec) {pre : List Nat} {t : Nat} {post : List Nat}, (Journal.fold ts rs).confirmed = pre ++ t :: post → ∃ tk, Journal.taskOf ts t = some tk ∧ ∀ (d : Nat), d ∈ tk.deps → d ∈ pre ∨ ∃ dt, Journal.taskOf ts d = some dt ∧ dt.na = true

theorems.name: LegionCore.Journal.sat_witness
theorems.statement: ∀ (ts : List Journal.JTask) (rs : List Journal.Rec), (∀ (p : Nat × Journal.K), p ∈ (Journal.fold ts rs).sat → ∃ r, r ∈ rs ∧ Journal.SatW ts p r) ∧ ∀ (e : Nat × Nat × Nat), e ∈ (Journal.fold ts rs).effects → ∃ r, r ∈ rs ∧ Journal.EffW e r

theorems.name: LegionCore.Journal.fold_append_prefix
theorems.statement: ∀ (ts : List Journal.JTask) (rs rs' : List Journal.Rec), ∃ ex, (Journal.fold ts (rs ++ rs')).confirmed = (Journal.fold ts rs).confirmed ++ ex

theorems.name: LegionCore.Journal.premature_never_counts
theorems.statement: ∀ {ts : List Journal.JTask} {s : Journal.FS} {r : Journal.Rec} {tk : Journal.JTask}, Journal.taskOf ts r.task = some tk → Journal.eligible ts s.confirmed tk = false → (Journal.ingest ts s r).sat = s.sat ∧ (Journal.ingest ts s r).effects = s.effects ∧ (Journal.ingest ts s r).obsOk = s.obsOk

theorems.name: LegionCore.Journal.closed_grounded
theorems.statement: ∀ (ts : List Journal.JTask) (rs : List Journal.Rec) {d : Nat}, d ∈ Journal.closedSet ts rs → d ∈ (Journal.fold ts rs).confirmed ∨ ∃ dt, dt ∈ ts ∧ dt.id = d ∧ dt.na = true

theorems.name: LegionCore.Journal.decision_deps_grounded
theorems.statement: ∀ {sp : Spec} {s : State} {r : Req} (ts : List Journal.JTask) (rs : List Journal.Rec), admission Guards.full sp { phase := s.phase, uid := s.uid, wid := s.wid, epoch := s.epoch, now := s.now, issued := s.issued, usedNonces := s.usedNonces, fenced := s.fenced, ledger := s.ledger, verified := s.verified, evidenced := s.evidenced, closed := Journal.closedSet ts rs, reports := s.reports, used := s.used, contract := s.contract, chash := s.chash, cver := s.cver, plan := s.plan } r = V.T → ∃ tk, sp.task? r.task = some tk ∧ ∀ (d : Nat), d ∈ tk.deps → d ∈ (Journal.fold ts rs).confirmed ∨ ∃ dt, dt ∈ ts ∧ dt.id = d ∧ dt.na = true
